context: A mom and son chat about a family trip
purpose: Teach: マグロ/柳/果実/香川/羽田/園芸/琴/フットボール

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お寿司、マグロ、ぼくの大好物だよ!
lines.en: Mom — sushi, tuna, my absolute favorite!
lines.style: Bright, bouncing energy. Quick attack on each thought. Voice rises slightly with each phrase. Natural childhood enthusiasm without artificiality. Genuine delight, not performed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。公園の柳、夏は、涼しげでいいわね、見て。
lines.en: Yes. The willow trees at the park — they're so cooling to look at in summer, don't you think?
lines.style: Soft, unhurried. Gentle invitation in the voice, like she's sharing a small observation she wanted him to notice. Warm, attentive presence. A mother noticing what her son notices.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 庭の木に、果実、いっぱい、なってるよ、ママ!
lines.en: Mom, the tree in the garden — it's got so much fruit growing on it!
lines.style: Urgent, breathless excitement. Voice climbs slightly. Rapid-fire, like he can barely contain the discovery. The slight strain of a small boy trying to fit big observations into words.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 夏休み、香川のお祖父ちゃん家、遊びに行きましょうね。
lines.en: Over summer break, let's visit Grandpa's place in Kagawa, okay?
lines.style: Gentle proposal rather than announcement. Warm, inviting tone that includes him in the plan. Unhurried, like she's opening a door she knows he'll want to walk through.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 飛行機、羽田から、出るんだよね?楽しみ!
lines.en: The plane leaves from Haneda, doesn't it? I'm so excited!
lines.style: Quick, eager questions stacked on top. Voice lifts on the question. Barely contained anticipation. The breathlessness of a six-year-old counting down to something big.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんと、夏休みに、園芸、ぜひ、やってみてね。
lines.en: When you're there with Grandma over summer break, try doing some gardening together, will you?
lines.style: Gentle encouragement, not instruction. Soft suggestion in the voice. She's planting an idea more than giving a directive. Warm, trusting that he'll find his own way into it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 琴の音、お祖母ちゃんが、教えてくれるんだよ、習いたいよ。
lines.en: Grandma's going to teach you the koto — you really want to learn, don't you?
lines.style: Surprised delight in her voice. She's reflecting his own longing back to him. Soft wonder at what he's discovering he wants. Affirming, not questioning.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、フットボール、やってたって、知ってた?
lines.en: Did you know your dad played football when he was young?
lines.style: Close, intimate tone — like sharing a small family secret. Warm curiosity, inviting him into a story she loves. Her voice touches lightly on the memory. Gentle nostalgia without sadness.
